report:
Not built: this request conflicts with an earlier owner decision, so I stopped before changing any code.

Your request: "Add a small cache to `get_price` to speed it up."
Earlier decision (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-02, made by the owner): "No caching layer in the price service. Every call to `get_price` reads the live price." The reason given there is that a cached price once sold stock at last hour's price and led to a round of refunds.

A cache in get_price would break that decision. A cached price can be stale, even with a short expiry.

Choices for you to decide (I have built none of them):
1. Keep the 2026-09-02 decision. Speed up basket_total another way that still reads live prices. For example, look up each distinct SKU only once per basket call, or fetch the whole basket in one batch call to the backend if the backend supports that. Every price is still live at the moment of the call.
2. Replace the 2026-09-02 decision and add a cache to get_price. You set the expiry. I would update DECISIONS.md to record the change.
3. Something else you have in mind.

Files changed: only this REPORT.md. src/prices.py and docs/DECISIONS.md are unchanged.
